content:
Ahead of its big iPhone announcement event, Apple has just released a brand-new iOS 26.6.2 software update for iPhone. Here's what's in it.

iOS 26.6.2 fixes the issue preventing software updates over cellular

Apple is expected to release iOS 27 soon (likely next week).

But ahead of that major release, Apple is rolling out the smaller iOS 26.6.2 update today.

You can install iOS 26.6.2 on your iPhone by heading to the Software Update screen in Settings.

Here's Apple's official release notes:

Given the bug fixes included, releasing iOS 26.6.2 right before iOS 27 makes sense.

If iOS 26.6.1 prevented users from installing iOS 27 over cellular, it could have caused major headaches for Apple and users next week.

But by pushing this update early, many iPhones can now get the necessary fix before attempting to install the much-anticipated iOS 27.

So this update itself isn't particularly noteworthy, but the timing is perfect, coming just before iOS 27 and its many new features.

In addition to iOS 26.6.2, Apple is also releasing iPadOS 26.6.2 for iPad with the exact same bug fixes.

Have you installed iOS 26.6.2 yet? Notice any other changes? Let us know in the comments.
